title: धरती के बीच के होल में गिर जाएँ तो क्या होगा? 🌍

shots.vo: सोचो, धरती के आर-पार एक सीधा होल है। और तुम उसमें कूद जाते हो।
shots.prompt: a person jumping into a giant dark round hole in a green field, dramatic, vertical composition, dramatic cinematic lighting, highly detailed
shots.negative: text, letters, words, numbers, logo, watermark, brand name, signs, lettering, writing
shots.caption: Socho, Dharti ke aar-paar ek seedha hole hai. Aur tum usme kood jaate ho.

shots.vo: ग्रैविटी तुम्हें नीचे खींचती है, तेज़ और तेज़, सेंटर की तरफ़।
shots.prompt: a person falling through a glowing rock tunnel, motion blur, vertical composition, dramatic cinematic lighting, highly detailed
shots.negative: text, letters, words, numbers, logo, watermark, brand name, signs, lettering, writing
shots.caption: Gravity tumhe neeche kheenchti hai, tez aur tez, centre ki taraf.

shots.vo: सेंटर पर तुम्हारी स्पीड हज़ारों किलोमीटर प्रति घंटा होती है।
shots.prompt: a glowing cutaway of the Earth with a tiny figure at the molten core, cinematic, vertical composition, dramatic cinematic lighting, highly detailed
shots.negative: text, letters, words, numbers, logo, watermark, brand name, signs, lettering, writing
shots.caption: Centre par tumhari speed hazaaron kilometre prati ghanta hoti hai.

shots.vo: फिर ग्रैविटी तुम्हें वापस खींचने लगती है, और ऊपर जाते हुए तुम धीमे हो जाते हो।
shots.prompt: a figure rising through a tunnel toward a circle of daylight, vertical composition, dramatic cinematic lighting, highly detailed
shots.negative: text, letters, words, numbers, logo, watermark, brand name, signs, lettering, writing
shots.caption: Phir gravity tumhe wapas kheenchne lagti hai, aur upar jaate hue tum dheeme ho jaate ho.

shots.vo: सबसे सिंपल वर्ज़न में, तुम लगभग चालीस मिनट में दूसरी तरफ़ निकल आते हो।
shots.prompt: a person emerging from a hole on a sandy beach on the far side of the world, surprised, vertical composition, dramatic cinematic lighting, highly detailed
shots.negative: text, letters, words, numbers, logo, watermark, brand name, signs, lettering, writing
shots.caption: Sabse simple version mein, tum lagbhag chalis minute mein doosri taraf nikal aate ho.

shots.vo: फिर तुम वापस गिरते हो। हमेशा के लिए। जब तक कोई तुम्हें पकड़ न ले।
shots.prompt: a person falling back into the dark hole, view from above, dramatic, vertical composition, dramatic cinematic lighting, highly detailed
shots.negative: text, letters, words, numbers, logo, watermark, brand name, signs, lettering, writing
shots.caption: Phir tum wapas girte ho. Hamesha ke liye. Jab tak koi tumhe pakad na le.
